title: Mr. X's work on exotic vacuum objects and self-organizing plasma

tellings.quote: And Mr. X, who just doesn't want to be named, he's not a government guy. He's just he's a savant. He's really is a savant. Um, he did so much work on EVOs, exotic vacuum objects, and this like self-organizing plasma.

plain: An unnamed man known only as Mr. X is said to have done a great deal of work around 2020 and 2021 on what he calls exotic vacuum objects, strange glowing forms thought to come out of empty space, and on plasma, a glowing electrically charged gas, that seems to organize itself. A guest named Jay Anderson tells this from what he knows of Mr. X, saying he is not a government man but "really is a savant" who simply does not want to be named.
